profile.role_note: Spectro Resonance Skill burst DPS; Incandescence stacks fed by coordinated attacks.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: The former queen — still a strong Spectro burst DPS, but she needs heavy investment to keep up in the current meta; only pull on a rerun if you love her playstyle.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Ages of Harvest (or Verdant Summit) + 5-piece Celestial Light in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout with Jué in the main slot. Aim for a Crit 4-cost, Spectro DMG 3-costs, ATK% 1-costs, and comfortable Energy Regen for consistent Liberation rotations; Zhezhi's coordinated attacks feed her Incandescence stacks.

ranked_weapons.name: Ages of Harvest
ranked_weapons.note: Her signature. Crit Rate, ATK, a 12% Attribute DMG buff, and a whopping 48% Resonance Skill DMG Bonus — her main damage type.

ranked_weapons.name: Verdant Summit
ranked_weapons.note: High ATK, Crit DMG, and stackable Heavy Attack DMG; viable swap if you already own it.

ranked_weapons.name: Lustrous Razor
ranked_weapons.note: Standard 5-star; ATK% substat and Energy Regen from the passive.

ranked_weapons.name: Helios Cleaver
ranked_weapons.note: Usable 4-star; stacking ATK% on Resonance Skill casts.

echo_sets.name: Celestial Light
echo_sets.note: Her Spectro set: Spectro DMG plus an extra buff when she uses her Intro Skill, which her Forte Circuit encourages. Jué synergizes with her combo.

echo_sets.name: Lingering Tunes
echo_sets.note: ATK-focused second best; Mech Abomination further increases her ATK.

echo_sets.name: Celestial Light + Lingering Tunes
echo_sets.note: Spectro DMG plus ATK while farming a full set.

stat_priorities.note: Balance Crit for her burst windows.

build.energy_regen_target: not published; enough for consistent Liberation rotations

teams.name: Premium: Jinhsi + Zhezhi + Shorekeeper

members.name: Jinhsi
members.note: Spectro burst DPS; needs Incandescence stacks, which Zhezhi maximizes with coordinated attacks.

members.name: Zhezhi
members.note: Coordinated attacks plus Resonance Skill DMG amplification via her Outro.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Stellarealm Crit buffs and healing; detonates Stellarealm with her enhanced Intro.

teams.rotation: Shorekeeper deploys Stellarealm, Zhezhi builds Forte with attacks, casts her empowered skills and Liberation, then Outro into Jinhsi: Overflowing Radiance on entry, build Incandescence with skills and Basics, enter Incarnation, and finish the burst combo.

teams.name: Alternative: Jinhsi + Zhezhi + Buling

members.name: Jinhsi
members.note: Same burst role; Buling and Zhezhi both buff her Resonance Skill DMG.

members.name: Zhezhi
members.note: Same coordinated-attack and Outro amplification role.

members.name: Buling
members.note: Resonance Skill DMG buff from her Forte-enhanced Liberation, healing, and team-wide DMG amplification.

teams.rotation: Buling runs her combo into Liberation and Outro to Zhezhi, Zhezhi builds Forte and casts her empowered skills plus Liberation, then Outro into Jinhsi's full burst combo.

sources.record: Buling Best Builds and Teams (Jinhsi team section)

sequences.verdict: S0 is a complete burst kit. Aim S1 first, stop at S3 for value, S6 only for whales.

pull_path.why: Full Incarnation, Ordination Glow, and Unison rotation works at S0.
Herald of Revival stacks boost her strongest hit, Illuminous Epiphany, up to +80%.
Up to +50% ATK from Immortal's Descendancy; the recommended stopping point for most players.
+45% Illuminous Epiphany multiplier plus stronger Incandescence scaling.

nodes.name: Abyssal Ascension
nodes.effect: Incarnation Basic/Crescent Divinity grant Herald of Revival (up to 4 stacks, 6s); Illuminous Epiphany consumes them for +20% DMG per stack.

nodes.name: Chronofrost Repose
nodes.effect: Restores 50 Incandescence after staying out of combat for 4s (once per 4s).

nodes.name: Celestial Incarnate
nodes.effect: Casting Intro Loong's Halo grants Immortal's Descendancy: +25% ATK per stack, up to 2, for 20s.

nodes.name: Benevolent Grace
nodes.effect: Casting Liberation or Illuminous Epiphany gives nearby Resonators 20% Attribute DMG Bonus for 20s.

nodes.name: Frostfire Illumination
nodes.effect: Liberation Purge of Light DMG multiplier increased by 120%.

nodes.name: Thawing Triumph
nodes.effect: Illuminous Epiphany DMG multiplier +45%, plus +45% more from consumed Incandescence.

sequences.weapon_vs_dupes: Signature Ages of Harvest before S1 - S0 plus signature beats chasing S1; pull dupes only after.
